in_marathi.name: Jasveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jasveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jas: victory, Veer: bringer. The name Jasveer is a term of respect and admiration, often given to those who have shown great courage and determination in their lives.
